odooInspector.connections.markdownDescription: Odoo databases this extension can connect to. Credentials are stored separately in the OS keychain via **Odoo: Set Credentials**.

name.description: A unique label for this connection.

url.description: Base URL, e.g. https://mycompany.odoo.com or http://localhost:8069.

login.description: Login of the user the credentials belong to.

authMode.markdownDescription: How to authenticate. `auto` treats long credentials as API keys. `password` exchanges the user's password for a session and always uses the `call_kw` API; it does not work for users with two-factor authentication enabled.

odooInspector.activeConnection.description: Name of the connection to use by default.

odooInspector.rateLimitPerSecond.description: Maximum requests per second. Odoo SaaS instances throttle aggressively; raise this only for local databases.

odooInspector.maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows returned to the language model.

odooInspector.queryGate.markdownDescription: When to open the Query Workbench so the user can review and edit a query before it is sent. `always` gates every tool call; `writes-only` gates only mutating calls; `never` runs queries immediately.

odooInspector.enableArbitraryMethodCalls.markdownDescription: Enables the `odoo_call_method` tool, which can invoke any public method on any model. This is effectively unrestricted access to the database.

languageModelTools.name: odoo_list_models
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the models available on the connected Odoo database.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the models available on the connected Odoo database, with their technical name and human label. Use this first when you do not know which model holds the data you need. Returns at most 500 models; filter with the 'filter' parameter to narrow the list.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the model name or label, e.g. 'sale' or 'invoice'.

languageModelTools.name: odoo_get_fields
languageModelTools.userDescription: Describe the fields of an Odoo model.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the field definitions of an Odoo model: technical name, label, type, whether it is stored, and for relational fields the target model. Always call this before building a domain or choosing fields, so you do not reference fields that do not exist.

fields.description: Optional subset of field names to describe. Omit to get all fields.

languageModelTools.name: odoo_search_read
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search records on an Odoo model and return the requested fields.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches records on an Odoo model and returns the requested fields. This is the main read tool. The user can review and edit the query — including which columns are returned — before it is sent, so propose a complete query rather than a minimal one. Domains use Odoo syntax: [["field", "operator", value], ...] with operators such as =, !=, >, <, in, ilike, child_of. Prefix with '&', '|', '!' for boolean logic. Call odoo_get_fields first if you are unsure of field names.

domain.description: Odoo search domain. Omit or use [] to match all records.

fields.description: Field names to return. Omit to let the user pick columns in the workbench.

limit.description: Maximum number of records. Defaults to 200.

order.description: Sort order, e.g. 'create_date desc' or 'name asc, id desc'.

languageModelTools.name: odoo_read_records
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read specific Odoo records by their database ids.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads specific records by their database ids. Use this when you already have ids from a previous search. Prefer odoo_search_read when you need to filter by field values.

ids.description: Database ids of the records to read.

fields.description: Field names to return. Omit for all fields.

languageModelTools.name: odoo_count_records
languageModelTools.userDescription: Count the records matching a domain.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Counts the records matching a domain, without fetching them. Use this to check how many records a query would return before reading them.

domain.description: Odoo search domain. Omit or use [] to count all records.

languageModelTools.name: odoo_call_method
languageModelTools.userDescription: Call an arbitrary method on an Odoo model. Disabled by default.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Calls any public method on an Odoo model. This is a powerful escape hatch: it can modify data. Prefer the dedicated read tools. Only use this when no other tool fits, and explain to the user what the call will do. This tool is disabled unless the user enables 'odooInspector.enableArbitraryMethodCalls'.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
